Clinical Studies Core Many of the clinical trials underway at the College of Veterinary Medicine are facilitated by the Clinical Studies Core (CSC). The CSC supports interactions between clinical and basic research groups within North Carolina State University and expands collaborative relationships beyond the university with practicing veterinarians, animal owners, and industry partners.
